title: Plain: な-Adjective だ
shortExplanation: The plain copula. な-adjectives are noun-like: they take だ rather than inflecting.
longExplanation: な-adjectives do not conjugate themselves; they attach the copula だ, exactly as a noun does. Learning the copula here therefore also covers noun + copula (学生だ).
formation: な-Adjective / Noun + だ: 静かだ, 学生だ.
